title: Anthropic Sets IPO Price Range at $70 to $78

quotes.text: Anthropic plans to sell 825 million shares at $70 to $78 each in its Nasdaq IPO, which could raise up to about $64.4 billion, an updated filing shows.
quotes.for: The price range and the size.

quotes.text: Nvidia, Google, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC have agreed to buy $26 billion of non-voting stock at the IPO price in a concurrent private placement.

Anthropic expects to price the offering on November 18 and begin trading on November 19, and is targeting a retail allocation of about 20%, well above the norm for an IPO, CNBC reported, citing people familiar with the details.

title: Google Gemini 4 Carbon is now available for complex AI tasks

quotes.text: Two weeks ago, Google gave Gemini 4 Carbon to a small group of cybersecurity defenders through its Fairwind Program.
Carbon ranked first on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity’s WANDR, and Zapier’s AutomationBench, and its cost per task was less than half that of the next best model from another company.
Paying developers and businesses can use it through the API in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business at Argon’s introductory rate of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.
